text:
the biggest lesson i've learned shipping side projects:

a lot of advice says build for other people, solve someone else's problem. that's totally valid. but for me, i also make sure it's something i actually want and would pay for myself. the signal i look for is simple: have i bought similar products before? if yes, i'm probably not the only one, and i can just build the version i wish existed.

that's literally how keeby started. i kept buying mechanical keyboards but couldn't bring the sound with me on my macbook. so i built it. real recorded switches, spatial audio, sub-3ms latency.

people doubted whether it was worth shipping. i shipped anyway. i've always loved shipping, marc lou's indie hacking got me hooked on the idea that you just keep putting things out there. so i did.

it hit #1 top paid on the mac app store, crossed $6k+ revenue, people sponsored me a free domain, and lofree even sponsored me their keyboards to record. but the best part wasn't the launch. it's that i got really close to my users. they send requests constantly, i filter for what's actually good, but most of their ideas are great and they love how fast i turn them around.

i just shipped 1.6.0, and half of it came straight from those requests:

- 7 new switches (lofree flow 2, akko cs jelly black, clicky pink, etc), one was contributed by a user and credited inside the app

- new what's new screen, new switches literally pour out of your notch into a glass jar with real physics

- 8d sound, your keystrokes orbit around your head (nobody asked, shipped it in a weekend)

- rebuilt the 3d spatial audio, measured against an actual binaural recording this time instead of tuning by ear

- mute right from the menu bar, fresh settings look, new icons, and the iqunix mq80 finally stopped squeaking
- more tweakd and updates

so the real lesson for me: solve a real problem, + is it something na bibilhin ko? then once it's out, let your users tell you where it goes next but of course still review it (don't blindly accept suggestions)

solo dev from ph. happy to talk shipping, audio, or indie stuff with anyone here!

https://getkeeby.com/

text:
Paano ko nga ba ipakikilala ang AI sa mga kids ko?

Bilang parent, alam kong hindi na maiiwasan ang AI. Katulad ng internet noon, magiging bahagi na rin ito ng araw-araw na buhay ng mga bata. Kaya imbes na pigilan o iwasan, mas gusto kong matutunan nila kung paano ito gamitin nang tama, ligtas, at may gabay.

Diyan nagsimula ang ideya ng Katoto.

Ang Katoto ay isang AI companion para sa mga bata at pamilya. Puwedeng magtanong ang mga bata tungkol sa homework, science, art, coding, o kahit mga bagay na curious sila. May voice chat din para sa mga batang mas komportable magsalita kaysa mag-type.

Pero hindi lang ito simpleng AI chatbot.

May safety layer para sa age-appropriate responses, memory system para maalala ni Katoto ang mga interes at projects ng bata, at parent dashboard para makita kung ano ang mga bagay na kinahihiligan at natututunan nila habang lumalaki.

May feature din na Show Katoto kung saan puwedeng ipakita ng mga bata ang kanilang drawings, school projects, LEGO builds, pets, at iba pang bagay na proud silang i-share.

Ang goal namin ay hindi gawing dependent ang mga bata sa AI. Ang goal ay tulungan silang maging mas curious, mas creative, at mas confident learners.

Libre itong subukan habang nasa beta pa kami.

text:
Hi everyone, I finally shipped my app and it's live on the Google Play Store. It's called pAI (yes, like pie, and a little like π).

pAI is a personal AI that cleans up the mess on your phone. You know that camera roll and downloads folder buried in screenshots, receipts, and random PDFs? pAI sorts all of that out for you. You just chat with it. Say "organize my files by month", "find invoice", or "rename these by date" and it goes and does it. And if you don't feel like typing, the suggestions are right there to tap.

You bring in the files yourself, so you pick exactly which photos and documents go into the app. Nothing gets pulled in without you choosing it.

It's also great for the files you always end up digging for at the worst possible moment. Your bank QR, a soft copy of your ID, your resume, a birth certificate, that screenshot of an item you wanted to check later. The random stuff you suddenly need, and pAI keeps it within reach.

Here's the part I care about most: it never touches your originals. It works on copies in its own space, so nothing gets moved or deleted behind your back. It runs fully offline too, so none of your files ever leave your phone.

And renaming is properly flexible. You set the name you want, then add things like a number, the date, the month, year, or even the original name, in whatever order makes sense to you. You see a live preview as you build it, and pAI can remember the format for that folder. So "IMG_4821" turns into whatever you actually want to call it.

Link to the app

Google Play Store
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dz.dev.personalai](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dz.dev.personalai)

**Dear App Builders PH**

**Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan!**

**I feel like this is a timely post/share.**

I want to share this version of Game of the Generals board game that I developed for both Android and iOS - built using Flutter with the help of AI of course.

I know there are other versions of this in the market already, but I want to make a difference, this has been a goal of mine to build way back as I used to play this with my father, and I wanna find a way to make this known outside the country if possible.

Just recently added a Campaign Mode with Eight arcs. Forty missions. Three centuries of Philippine resistance - from Sultan Kudarat's stand in Mindanao (1619) to the fall of Bataan (1942). Where some levels adds twist to the usual game mechanics (e.g Infiltrate-mode only, No generals should be eliminated, Spies are faced up and many more.)

I also made it in a way that the lobby is post-based where you don't have to have the app open all the time, say you're available to play within the next 1-4 hours, you can set a challenge, close the app and if another player would want to take it, they can accept it and you'll be notified that someone has accepted the challenge then you both can start the game.

You can play with AI/bot that adapts to your behavior through MCTS.

Thinking of season challenges, with possible awards/cash prize and of course tournaments - should the user base grow.

Would really appreciate if you can all try and give some feedback, would be happy to hear everyones thoughts.

Feel free to share with your friends and family please!

Thank you!

text:
Good day everyone. 

I would like to share the recent thing I built vibe coding; Good Word. 

Good Word is a vouch based odd job listing platform where you, a customer, can post a worker you hired before (or still working for you on an on call bases) and did a great job, or is a reliable and honest worker. Once posted, anyone who visits the web app can see recommendations for specific jobs, and contact them. 

How it works:
Anyone can post a workers name, contact number, trade, and post it (of course with consent from the worker). They get listed on the app. So if anyone is in need of lets say an electrician, or a plumber, they can search for one within their location. 

The reason why I built this is because

1. It's hard to find workers you can actually trust — which is exactly why vouching is the way. You're seeing people that real, identifiable folks are willing to back.

2. We all know someone who does great work for these jobs, but we don't all know each other. This bridges that gap — it turns "I know a good person for that" into something you can easily pass on. Word of mouth is still the best marketing; this just makes it easier to share.

3. Honest, hardworking people in these trades deserve more attention. This helps the right workers get noticed for the quality they bring.

I know there is a big flaw lalo na pag dating sa pag post ng worker cause anyone can just put whoever's number there na pwedeng gawing prank. Kaya right now I'm looking for a developer of an OTP and SMS provider to tighten the guard rails on this. Baka merong interested to collab with me on this. 

Please feel free to send me a message. Thank you!

text:
Been working silently on this project for about a year now, and I’m finally at the stage where I need some early beta testers to break it. 

It’s an open-source desktop app called Facenox. Basically, it’s a local-first attendance tracking system that just runs on standard hardware using a basic webcam and local computer vision models. The whole idea is to help small businesses like cafes, clinics, or warehouses skip buying expensive biometric hardware. People can just walk past the camera to clock in or out. 

The core app runs entirely on the local machine. Frontend is Electron and React 19, while the heavy CV pipeline is handled by a Python/FastAPI backend bundled via PyInstaller. I'm using ONNX Runtime for face detection, ByteTrack for tracking, and on-device liveness/anti-spoofing detection so it actually runs smoothly without needing a dedicated GPU. Local data sits on SQLite.

Privacy-wise, everything on the machine is encrypted via AES-256-GCM, and raw photos are discarded right after processing. It only saves the feature vectors.

To be transparent about the cloud aspect: the desktop app works fully independently without any internet connection. But I did build an optional remote dashboard using Next.js 15, Postgres, and Drizzle. If a business owner wants to check logs off-site, the desktop app can sync the local data to the web dashboard (free tier up to 10 people). If they don't want cloud sync, they can just run it completely without it.

It's open source under AGPLv3.

Since I've been staring at this same codebase for a year, I really need fresh eyes on it. Looking for some honest feedback, code audits.

Builds are ready for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

Repo: github.com/facenox/facenox

Let me know what you think!

text:
🚀 Update: Utang Free PH is coming to Android!

Some people here asked when the Android version would be available. Good news—it's almost ready.

BUT.. before it can be released on Google Play, Google requires a closed testing phase with at least 12 testers who keep the app installed for 14 days.

If you'd like to help:

✅ Send me your Gmail address via DM 
✅ I'll send you a testing invite
✅ Install the app and keep it on your phone for 14 days
✅ Optional but highly appreciated: Share any feedback, bugs, or feature suggestions

For those hearing about it for the first time, Utang Free PH is a free debt payoff planner built for Filipinos. It helps you organize and prioritize which debts to pay first to save interest such as credit cards, GCash loans, BNPL, Pag-IBIG loans, salary loans, and more.

The app shows:
• Which debt to pay first
• How much interest you can save
• Your estimated debt-free date

Your data stays on your device and isn't stored on any server.

I built this project to make debt management more accessible for Filipinos, and your help with testing would mean a lot.

If you're interested, send me your Gmail address and I'll add you to the Android test group.

📱 iPhone users can already download "Utang Free PH" on the App Store.

text:
Good day mga builders!

Share ko lang itong bagong update sa app ko.

Most expense tracker apps are focused lang sa personal expenses.

Pero let’s be real, hindi naman lahat ng gastos at collections ay personal lang. Minsan may kasama tayong family, friends, church, organization, o community na kailangan ding i-manage.

Personally, sa church namin, may weekly at monthly contributions kami na minamanage lang through Facebook Messenger. Nandoon lahat ng updates, reminders, at pagsesend ng mga GCash receipts. Habang tumatagal, napansin ko na medyo mahirap nang i-track kung sino na ang nakapagbayad, sino pa ang pending, at minsan kailangan pang mag-backread para hanapin ang mga resibo.

Doon ko naisip, what if i-improve ko ang app ko para hindi lang siya pang-personal finance, kundi makatulong din sa pag-manage ng community o group contributions?

Kaya excited akong i-share na available na ngayon ang Groups feature sa app ko! 👥

Now, bukod sa personal expense tracking, budgeting, at receipt scanning, pwede mo na ring gamitin ang Monnei para sa:

💰 Paluwagan

⛪ Church offerings at ministry funds

🏘️ HOA dues

👨‍👩‍👧 Family funds

🏠 Shared expenses ng roommates o magkakaibigan

🎉 Group trips at events

Pwede mong:

✅ I-track kung sino na ang nagbayad

✅ Makita kung sino pa ang pending

✅ Mag-upload ng payment proofs

✅ Mag-manage ng shared expenses at contributions

✅ Panatilihing organized ang lahat sa isang lugar

Hindi ko pa rin binabago ang core ng Monnei as expense tracker, nandiyan pa rin ang mga features para sa personal finance. Dinagdagan ko lang ng paraan para mas madali ring mag-manage ng pera kapag grupo na ang involved.

If sa tingin niyo magiging useful ito sa church, organization, paluwagan, o kahit sa pamilya ninyo, I’d love to hear your feedback and suggestion 🙏

text:
Following Abakada.org's suite of free and open-source productivity tools for education, I'm officially launching another advocacy project today. Born out of critical necessity, HIV Care Philippines is a digital lifeline for Filipino people living with HIV and AIDS.

In the Philippines, receiving a diagnosis is only the beginning of an incredibly daunting journey. Beyond the physical toll, PLHIV routinely face overwhelming societal stigma, deep-rooted discrimination, and a profound lack of public awareness. 

Compounding this emotional weight is the exhausting, frustrating struggle to simply find a safe, active, and nearby treatment hub.

When individuals gather the courage to seek help, they deserve an immediate, clear path to care. Instead, many are met with an official Philippine Department of Health (https://doh.gov.ph/) website that is unorganized, outdated, and unresponsive, adding immense and unnecessary stress to people who are already fighting for their lives.

To break down these systemic barriers, I built HIV Care Philippines.

This independent web application provides a faster, highly reliable, and deeply empathetic user experience. Built using official DOH datasets, it simplifies the journey by mapping out all 338 designated facilities across the country so PLHIV can find secure care without confusion or fear.

This project is completely free, non-commercial, and fully transparent. It exists solely to serve our community, embrace those who feel left behind by society, and offer tangible hope that management and healing are entirely possible.

Please support this initiative by sharing this link with our kababayans. Together, we can replace isolation with access, and ensure that no Filipino PLHIV ever has to face this battle alone:   

Facebook: HIV Care Philippines

Happy to answer any questions or hear thoughts from fellow builders!

sharedPost.text:
**TLDR – medyo mahaba, sorry na agad 😅**

Gusto ko lang i-share yung app na ginawa ko. Originally, ginawa ko lang talaga siya para sa sarili ko—kasi after trying a lot of fitness apps, parang wala pa rin yung “all-in-one” na hinahanap ko.

Few months ko na rin siyang ginagamit, and dito ko na-realize na ang daming kulang sa typical apps, especially pagdating sa real-life situations like:

* paano kung kulang ka sa tulog
* may sakit ka
* masakit katawan mo
* or gusto mo pa rin mag-workout kahit hindi ka 100%

Most apps kasi static lang—walang adjustment based sa actual condition mo that day.

Same sa nutrition. Dati, aminin ko… “mema” lang din ako 😂

* “konti lang kakainin ko para pumayat”
* “wag na ako mag-rice”
* or worse, hindi kakain tapos babawi kinabukasan

Alam kong marami rin nakakarelate dyan haha.

---

So ayun, I decided to build something na mas adaptive and realistic.

**What the app does:**

* Automatic calorie & macro calculation (pwede pa via photo 📸)
* Progressive overload tracking (reps / weight / sets / feedback per session)
* Auto-adjusted workouts based on how you feel *before and after* training
* Smart TDEE adjustments based on your lifestyle
* AI Coach (beta)
* Live activity tracking (walk/run/hike, parang Strava) (beta)
* AI Form Coach (beta)

---

Quick personal note lang —
Hindi ako bodybuilder or fitness influencer. Beginner din ako in a lot of ways, and honestly… ongoing pa rin yung sarili kong progress.

Pero yun din yung reason kung bakit ko ginawa to.
I wanted something na makakatulong sa mga tulad ko—yung hindi perfect, pero consistent na sumusubok maging better.

---

Hindi siya perfect—and ako din hindi 😅
I’m still working on improving both the app and myself. Pero ginawa ko siya with the goal na maging useful talaga sa real people, hindi lang ideal scenarios.

Madami pa akong features na gustong idagdag and i-improve.
